headline: New York City's pension chief asked AI company Anthropic to delay its share sale.
body: Mark Levine, the city's top money official, wants Anthropic's safety checks set out first. He cannot block the share sale, and Anthropic has not answered yet.

headline: Insurance against tech firms failing to repay debt hit record prices on AI fears.
body: Data centre operator CoreWeave suffered most, as investors worry AI borrowers cannot pay. Reuters says its price means over a 64% risk of not paying in five years.

headline: Finance chiefs of the rich G7 nations agreed to practice for an AI cyber attack.
body: Satsuki Katayama, Japan's finance minister, said the drills will test responses and update manuals. The plan follows a warning from the International Monetary Fund, but no dates are set.

headline: TSMC is in talks to join Tesla chief Elon Musk's planned Texas chip plant.
body: TSMC, the largest contract chip maker, said any such plant must be run by TSMC. Musk has said his own companies will build and run it, and nothing is signed.

headline: Apple's boss said Apple will look at every option to beat a memory chip shortage.
body: John Ternus, Apple's chief executive, called the shortage a serious crisis but named no supplier. Korean paper Chosun Ilbo reads this as room for Chinese chips, which US senators oppose.

headline: Volvo plans hands-free driving on local roads, built on chip maker Nvidia's AI.
body: The system would handle traffic lights and turns, but drivers must watch the road. Volvo only promises it before 2030 and has not named which models come first.

headline: Car maker Faraday Future launched a small humanoid robot for developers at $2,490.
body: A $299 teaching version is aimed at schools. But the robot walks very slowly, and only 100 are made at first.

headline: Meta released a very large AI model that anyone can download to run on Macs.
body: Meta says Muse Spark Open beats other free-to-download models, based on its own tests. It needs at least 1 terabyte of memory and works best on Apple's Mac Studio.

headline: OpenAI's ChatGPT can now read the tabs you have open in Google's Chrome browser.
body: An updated Chrome add-on lets ChatGPT compare open pages, like three sofas you might buy. Its Work mode can even fill in forms and send messages; no safeguards were described.

headline: Google made a key quantum computer part with fewer errors, on a real chip.
body: Google's team got about 40 times fewer errors in these parts, in one small test. Making them the old way was expected to use up to 95% of a machine.

headline: OpenAI's coding agent got all but one of 50 unpublished physics problems right.
body: Each answer cost under $3, in a test built by Harvard and Google DeepMind researchers. The authors say AI still lacks the taste to choose good problems.

headline: A US regulator ordered OpenAI and Anthropic to hand over AI safety incident files.
body: The Federal Trade Commission, which protects consumers, also wants their privacy policies and safeguards. A spokesperson confirmed the demands, which are not a finding of wrongdoing.

headline: US regulators cleared an AI tool that estimates if early breast cancer will return.
body: Made by SimBioSys, it reads an existing breast scan and lab results before surgery. It was tested only on past records, and insurers do not cover it yet.

headline: Some US firms are hiring fewer people after investing in AI, the Fed reports.
body: The Federal Reserve's latest business survey heard this in five of its twelve regions. Most regions saw little job change, and the survey rests on what bosses told it.

headline: MIT researchers left AI agents alone on a virtual island, and one built a temple.
body: Each agent got a lobster body and thirty hours with no instructions. Six found a throwing trick nobody had coded, which the researchers compare to animal play.

headline: Anthropic let six outside safety testers work inside the company with staff-level access.
Drug maker AstraZeneca hired AI firm insitro to hunt for liver and heart drug targets.
Cameroon banned nursery and primary school pupils from using AI chatbots like ChatGPT.
Microsoft finished training a giant AI model it says needs far less computing power.
Borrowing for AI costs more: debt fears hit records as chip demand stays strong.
body: Insuring CoreWeave's data centre debt hit a record as chipmaker TSMC made record profit. Watch Meta's results on 21 October: less spending means weaker demand.
